upstream.reception_share_by_iata_exact_counts_and: Reception share by IATA. Exact counts and percentages follow in the table.
upstream.when_and_where_observers_report_receptio: When and where observers report receptions.
upstream.could_not_load_traffic_try_refreshing: Could not load traffic. Try refreshing.
upstream.counts_are_reported_receptions_not_uniqu: Counts are reported receptions, not unique packets. Blank hours have no retained hourly record; they do not establish an outage. Times are UTC and the latest hour may be partial.
upstream.no_retained_receptions_in_this_window: No retained receptions in this window.
upstream.charts_group_smaller_areas_into_other_ia: Charts group smaller areas into “Other IATAs”; this table keeps every area.
upstream.could_not_load_signal_data_try_refreshin: Could not load signal data. Try refreshing or choosing a shorter time period.
upstream.signal_measured_by_observers_on_the_last: Signal measured by observers on the last hop. Charts count retained receptions and use UTC time.
upstream.utc_end_exclusive_completehour_snapshots: UTC (end exclusive). Complete-hour snapshots refresh in the background; the current hour is excluded. Blank hours lack retained records.
upstream.each_mean_weights_every_available_recept: Each mean weights every available reception equally. Missing includes absent, invalid and zero/zero unavailable readings; a measured zero SNR remains valid. SNR and RSSI can have different sample counts. These readings do not measure end-to-end quality or packet loss, and colors are not quality thresholds.
upstream.bins_include_the_lower_bound_and_exclude: Bins include the lower bound and exclude the upper bound. The outer bins include all values beyond the display range. Hourly means below are rounded to one decimal place.
upstream.hashwidth_share_among_nonempty_ordinary_: Hash-width share among nonempty ordinary paths. Empty, trace and unclassified records are excluded. Exact counts follow below.
upstream.path_classification_for_all_retained_rec: Path classification for all retained receptions. The four categories partition the total; exact counts follow alongside.
upstream.how_received_packets_carry_route_hashes: How received packets carry route hashes.
upstream.could_not_load_path_data_try_refreshing_: Could not load path data. Try refreshing or choosing a shorter time period.
upstream.path_entries_reported_by_observers_count: Path entries reported by observers, counted per reception. Hash-width shares use nonempty hash paths.
upstream.flood_paths_accumulate_entries_direct_ro: Flood paths accumulate entries; direct routes contain remaining entries. Empty paths have no hash-width vote. Trace headers carry signal readings. Unclassified records lack usable payload or path metadata.
upstream.exact_width_pathlength_and_hourly_values: Exact width, path-length and hourly values
upstream.length_counts_include_validated_ordinary: Length counts include validated ordinary empty paths at zero. In the trend, recorded hours with no hash paths show zero; absent hours remain gaps.
upstream.retained_data_and_memberships_for_the_se: Retained data and memberships for the selected region.
upstream.could_not_load_scopes_try_refreshing: Could not load scopes. Try refreshing.
upstream.an_observer_can_appear_in_more_than_one_: An observer can appear in more than one scope. Global observer counts include stored memberships; regional counts use retained scoped receptions. Nodes are counted in their default scope. These counts have no selected time window.
upstream.charts_show_the_largest_12_scopes_plus_a: Charts show the largest 12 scopes plus any remainder. The table keeps all matching scopes.
upstream.choose_a_valid_start_and_a_later_end_tim: Choose a valid start and a later end time.
upstream.showing_50_observers_search_to_find_othe: Showing 50 observers. Search to find others.
upstream.search_includes_all_matching_observers_i: Search includes all matching observers in the selected region.
upstream.compare_distinct_flood_packets_reported_: Compare distinct flood packets reported by two observers over any retained time period.
upstream.this_comparison_link_has_invalid_or_miss: This comparison link has invalid or missing values. Choose observers and dates below.
upstream.no_flood_packets_were_reported_by_either: No flood packets were reported by either observer in this period and region.
upstream.percentages_use_the_union_of_packets_hea: Percentages use the union of packets heard by either observer. Repeated receptions count once. These counts reflect retained reports, not radio packet loss; an offline observer, broker interruption or expired history can affect the result.
upstream.reported_position_is_outside_this_server: Reported position is outside this server's configured local borders.

charts.scopeDescription: Counts by transport scope. Exact values for all matching scopes are listed in the table.
charts.trafficDescription: Hourly reported receptions by IATA. Gaps mean no retained hourly record. Exact totals follow in the data table.
charts.heatmapDescription: Activity heatmap by UTC day and hour. Brighter cells indicate more reported receptions; blank cells have no retained record.
charts.signalDescription: Available and unavailable readings for SNR and RSSI. Exact counts and percentages are in the sample availability table.
charts.pathsDescription: Hourly receptions carrying nonempty 1, 2 or 3-byte hash paths, UTC. Absent hours remain gaps. Exact values follow in the hourly table.
charts.histogramDescription: {{name}} distribution in {{unit}}. Exact bin boundaries and counts follow below.
charts.meanDescription: Hourly mean {{name}} in {{unit}}, UTC. Missing readings remain gaps. Exact values are in the hourly table.
charts.pathLengthDescription: Received path entries per reception. Zero means an empty ordinary path. Trace and unclassified records are excluded. Exact counts follow in the table.
